git_title: [MAIN-EXP] D1-Z: audit action and objective-event threshold crossings
question: Where does the frozen Stage-3C-33 exposure-only alignment contrast stop: continuous Subject-VM decision divergence, sampled-action crossing, objective-event crossing, or later aggregation?

analysis_contract.continuous_decision_measure: exposure-by-alignment difference-in-differences of guarded-live-minus-control Subject-VM action potentials
analysis_contract.sampled_action_crossing_measure: guarded-live action transition from horizon-control to extended-exposure, separated into alignment-common and alignment-differential transitions
analysis_contract.objective_event_crossing_measure: component-wise exposure-by-alignment difference-in-differences of objective-event facts
analysis_contract.aggregation_check: sum event contrasts within stable subject, then balance subjects exactly as Stage 3C-33

frozen_interpretation.exact_margin_observability_limit: full masked policy logits and the counter-based categorical draw are not persisted in the frozen trace

next_boundary: A disjoint-source Stage 3C-35 replication may preregister the prediction that alignment-differential sampled-action crossings identify all nonzero exposure-only fact sources. It may not select responsive seeds, change exposure, add a value function, or add retention. Exact numeric threshold-margin analysis is blocked until a separately typed export-instrumentation change persists full masked policy logits and the categorical draw without changing sampling semantics.
